items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Art Blakey was working not too far from there... So they went up and told Art Blakey, and Art sent me a foot pedal.

ctx.x: And especially the foot. So I’m playing and you know Major’s looking at me. And so finally, Joe said, all right Jackie. Art Blakey was working not too far from there. Thank God he was working close by. So they went up and told Art Blakey, and Art sent me a foot pedal. So I finished the gig out. But it was so funny at one point because after that happened, Major says, “You mean to tell me you worked me to death?” You know how funny he is. And he would stop people, and he would put yeast in the story. And I’d say…
Who are some of the vocalists that you’ve had a chance to work behind? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
